name: Tokugawa Iemitsu
source:
The third shogun of the Tokugawa Shogunate.
The story starts of because of an order he issued which had his younger brother, Tokugawa Tadanaga, taking his life by means of seppuku. Due to this, he earned the scorn of Tadanaga's loyal supporters such as Asakura Nobumasa. He may look young, but he is a man of deep piety and has all the qualities of a leader.
